desc: 灰棚撞色两件套：宽圆领落肩短袖＋侧织带开衩五分裤
leaf: 女童宽圆领落肩印花短袖配侧织带开衩五分裤两件套
name: 女童宽圆领侧织带五分裤两件套款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：在合规纸白底上把整套廓形、宽圆领与前胸矩形图位一次交代清楚。
主图一秒法则：在同一面水泥灰棚里用整套上身加一条栏目细线，把头号卖点一秒讲完。
shots.textZone: upper-left header slot flanked by double hairline rules, one headline beneath it, one subline and one square index chip beside the subline

shots.intent: 放大夏日童装最难伺候的三件事：领口下滑、肩线扭转、裤侧卷边，把整套解法摆在同一格里。
shots.textZone: one short label slot centred under each panel

shots.intent: 用源图真实的棚拍连拍语感做代入：一件坐具、一面灰墙、一套穿搭，把上身比例讲可信。
把第一决策点（领口与肩线做法）做成可信结构证据，替代原文案里的形容词承诺。
shots.textZone: header slot flanked by double hairline rules in the top band, one label slot under the crop

shots.intent: 用微距证明整套最大的结构差异：外缝双织带与侧开衩裤脚，细节即卖点。
shots.textZone: three short label slots on one hairline row under the macro crop

shots.intent: 连拍第二格补背面与活动量：背影加抬臂，让版型松量与后背图位同时可信。
俯拍搭配格回答一套能不能穿出门：整套加素色鞋帽，给出可信的穿着完整性。
给买家可选项：同机位同光的两个配色方框卡加方形色块，选款不靠猜。
shots.textZone: one colour label slot and one square swatch chip under each card, header slot flanked by double hairlines in the top band

shots.intent: 把源图后半段的多格实拍连拍转成可复用证据格：四格各指一处做法，不写形容词。
shots.textZone: one label slot under each of the four panels, header slot flanked by double hairlines along the top

shots.intent: 用可核对的洗护符号带与留空尺码梯收口，消除下单前的最后两个疑虑，不写任何实测数值。
shots.textZone: header slot flanked by double hairlines at the top, a blank size ladder of empty cells, a square-cell care band, one short note line beneath

style.backgroundSystem: one continuous poured-cement studio cyclorama in mid grey #9AA0A4 swept floor to wall as the recurring stage, seamless paper-white studio sweep #FFFFFF for packshot, spec and flat-lay fields, and one deep charcoal matte panel #101113 reserved for the two construction macro screens; no outdoor street locations, no furnished interiors, no second wall colour
style.direction: neutral cement-studio girls apparel commerce, single-wall lookbook cadence with rectilinear hairline grids and clean infographic discipline
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons inside hairline square cells in #101113, plus one solid square index chip in #DB202C used only as a tick or a colour swatch; no circular icon plates, no round magnifier windows, no circular photo masks, no scalloped seals, no certificate or badge artwork
style.lightingSystem: neutral daylight-balanced 5600K softbox key from the upper left with a large bounce card on the shadow side, low contrast, soft wrap into the grey wall, true contact shadows under every hem, no rim glow, no coloured gels, no warm cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent neutral cement-studio girls apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless paper-white studio sweep #FFFFFF, mid cement-grey poured-cement cyclorama #9AA0A4, one scarlet spot #DB202C used only for hairlines, index chips and ticks, and charcoal ink #101113 for text and frames; neutral daylight-balanced 5600K softbox key from the upper left with a large bounce fill, low contrast and true contact shadows under every hem; one modern geometric sans-serif, every Chinese section header flanked by double hairline rules with one wide-tracked micro-rail slot beneath it; hairline square photo frames on an open white gutter, rectilinear triptych and two-by-two contact-sheet grids, never circular photo masks or round magnifier windows; thin single-weight line icons inside square cells only; the pair always shown together at identical scale as a ghost-mannequin set, on a generic child body cropped below the neck, or laid flat in wearing position; no color palette changes, no new accent hues, no mixed fonts, no handwriting or script, no random backgrounds, no outdoor street or interior room scenery, no inconsistent lighting direction, no missing contact shadows, no circular masks or magnifier windows, no identifiable child face.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent hues beyond the scarlet spot #DB202C
no mixed fonts, no serif, no handwritten or outline lettering
no random backgrounds, no outdoor street scenery and no furnished interior rooms
no inconsistent lighting direction, no missing contact shadows and no warm cast over the grey stage
no circular photo masks, no round magnifier windows and no seal or badge artwork
no identifiable child face, no teen or adult proportions and no adult styling on children's garments
no redrawn garment graphics, no legible characters or numerals in the chest graphic block and no third-party character marks or trademark graphics
style.presentationRules: the pair is always shown together at identical scale, either as a ghost-mannequin set square to the frame, on a generic child body cropped below the neck, or laid flat in wearing position; the rectangular chest graphic block stays square-on and unobstructed; the outer-seam woven tape and the side-slit hems stay readable in at least one screen; hero scale never shifts more than five percent between screens
style.surfaceSystem: the same poured-cement studio floor #9AA0A4 continuing behind the sweep, matte paper-white floor and table field #FFFFFF for flat lays and cards, charcoal matte board #101113 under the macro screens; one scuffed painted steel drum seat in paper white #FFFFFF with a worn charcoal top #101113 as the only furniture
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for headlines and labels, every Chinese section header flanked by double hairline rules with one wide-tracked micro-rail slot beneath it, charcoal ink #101113 on paper white, labels in a 10-14pt scale and headlines in a 28-46pt scale, no serif, no handwriting, no script, no outline lettering
